description: Which run directories and sessions under code/results/ feed the paper artefacts (scripts/analyze.py --selection, the default). Every measurement record under this directory must be included by 'machines' or excluded by an 'exclude' rule with a reason; analyze.py refuses uncovered records. Exclude 'path' entries are path globs, not block-id globs: each is matched (fnmatch, '*' also matches '/') against machine/run/session/block and each of its prefixes, and against the file path relative to results_root; an optional 'match' restricts the rule to records whose fields match. A session is the directory holding the session-level schedule.json; <session>/stages/<tag>/ holds per-stage metadata and is never a session. 'supersede' rules exclude, among included records, every older record of a cell that a listed newer run re-measured (inert until that run exists; run_dir globs likewise). 'expected_rows' lists the rows each table must have (per table one {key column: [values]} product, or a list of them whose union is required). 'omissions' lists table cells that are pending re-measurement or documented omissions (selector TABLE|ROW|COLUMN, ROW = the table's key columns joined by commas); they apply only to missing or not-applicable cells (and absent expected rows, TABLE|ROW|(row), and FAIL codegen reports via T11|...|Scalar Status and T3|codegen,<tag>|Scalar Status selectors), never to integrity errors, and analyze.py warns about omission patterns that match no cell.
